subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw merge these standalone, currently unused core termination/GSAR primitives now, move them to another API boundary, or keep the work behind the linked feature tracker until production sessions_send integration and trusted-evidence scoring are settled?
rationale: The code is useful groundwork, but current main still has only numeric A2A caps, the new production modules are intentionally allowlisted as unused, and repository vision keeps core lean unless maintainers choose the API direction.

options.title: Fix proof text, then owner-approve core groundwork
options.body: Correct the demo summary mismatch and let an agents owner explicitly accept the unused core primitives as intentional foundation work.

options.title: Move or defer behind the tracker
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue as canonical and move the primitives to agent-core, plugin SDK, or a follow-up production integration once the boundary is chosen.

options.title: Accept unused core API risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge the library-only modules now and own the future placement and integration cost.
